titulo: Conjugate querer in the simple future
subtitulo: Querer loses its e and keeps a double r: querré, querrás, querremos.
regla: Querer drops the e of its infinitive to make the stem querr- (with double r), then adds -é, -ás, -á, -emos, -án.

bloques.texto: **Querer** (_to want_; also _to love_ a person) is irregular in the **simple future** (**futuro imperfecto**): the endings are normal, but the stem is not.
The **e** of the infinitive disappears, and the two **r**'s end up side by side: **quer(e)r-** → **querr-**.
Remember the **double r** in every form. It sounds like a rolled **rr**, just like **perro**.
Tip: the dropped **e** leaves the two **r**'s hugging. Roll them: **querrrré**.

lista.es: Después de rolar, ==querré== unos tacos de carne asada.
lista.en: After rolling, I'll want some carne asada tacos.

lista.es: Cuando veas esas olas, ==querrás== sacar la tabla.
lista.en: When you see those waves, you'll want to take out the board.

lista.es: No sé qué ==querrá== el cliente: ¿copia o llave nueva?
lista.en: I don't know what the customer will want: a copy or a new key?

lista.es: Creo que ==querremos== sembrar más tomates en el huerto.
lista.en: I think we'll want to plant more tomatoes in the garden.

lista.es: Ustedes ==querrán== ver el Rocinante por dentro, ¿no?
lista.en: You'll want to see the Rocinante inside, won't you?

lista.nota: The **ie** of the present (**quiero**) never appears in the future.

secciones.titulo: Other verbs that drop the e

lista.texto: **saber** → **sabr-**, **caber** → **cabr-**. See [[5245|caber and saber in the future]].
The endings are the same as for every verb in the future: [[5155|regular verbs in the simple future]].
The present changes **e** → **ie**: [[5774|querer in the present]].
The conditional uses the very same stem, with **-ía** endings: [[5055|the conditional]].
The future also guesses about right now: [[5060|the future for probability]].
The future of **haber** + participle: [[5066|irregular verbs in the future perfect]].

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: **Querer**, **ellos**: Mis primos ___ ir a la playa.
lista.r: Mis primos querrán ir a la playa.

lista.p: In Spanish: _I don't know what she'll want._
Which one? **¿Querás más tortillas?** or **¿Querrás más tortillas?**
